title: App page route goes blank (React error #31) when a page's label is the spec's inline locale map (I18nLabel { zh-CN, en })
body:
Category: ① defect with reach. An app that gives a page an inline-locale `label` (`PageSchema.label` is `string | I18nLabel`) can blank that page's route for every viewer: the app header renders the map as a React child.

**Business reason:** apps translate page names the same way they translate reports (objectui#13470). Today the page breaks instead of showing the name in the viewer's language, so the only workaround is a single-language label.

**Who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat (app-shell `AppHeader`). This is the page-route twin of objectui#13470, whose PR objectui#13487 fixes the report branch of the same header.

**Dedupe:** searched objectui for "page label inline locale map React error 31 AppHeader page title I18nLabel blank" (25 hits, all closed or other surfaces: #13470 report, #13380 public form, #11158 Studio nav rail, #11299 nav entry, #12358 grid column) and objectstack for "page label locale map crash" (0). No card names the page route.

## Reach

Measured once by the objectui#13470 card session (report comment on objectui#13470, `out_of_scope_findings`). It mounted the real `AppHeader` at `/apps/srm/page/welcome` with the real `useObjectLabel`, and set that page's label to `{ 'zh-CN': …, en: … }`. Result: `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {zh-CN, en})`. The probe was a test harness and was not committed; the page has not been measured in a running console yet.

## Where

`packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` on main `c85408f`, page branch: `const fallback = pageDef?.label || humanizeSlug(pageName); routeTitle = pageLabel({ name: pageName, label: fallback });`. `pageLabel` returns a fallback it cannot translate untouched, so a map reaches the render. The report branch had the same shape, and objectui#13487 resolves it with `metadataText` in the viewer's language.

## Expected

The page title resolves to the viewer's locale (en and zh-CN), as object, field and (after objectui#13487) report labels do. A plain-string label keeps today's output. Check the page's own heading and any other surface that prints `pageDef.label` raw in the same PR.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 session `session_01XWGTsmqrtrt1Zqh1ioWqsT` from the card session's report.
